title: Compare a full reference process without forcing identical error histories
statement: The fixed-T expansion of E_framed=(1-b)E_exact+bF has an all-clean branch equal to the true-extraction process with the same starting memory/controller. Other branches may have different histories. Every permitted common tester has distance <=1-(1-b)^T. Known deterministic b_t use product_t(1-b_t); random history-dependent allowances need additional justification.

requires: A complete Pauli/gauge source law specified on all allowed histories and a fixed or persistently qualified receiver
State-uniform extraction Bell fidelity >=1-b for EVERY emitted gauge state, equivalent to T0>=(1-b)I
Fresh private frames, no later key access, genuinely discarded gauge/decoder records and common permitted controllers
provides: A complete finite adaptive-service comparison supporting output reuse at the declared ports
assumptions: Initial full payload/reference independence is needed for a payload-only channel; enlarged complete identities handle initial correlations separately
Keys must be retired before later control, not only absent from final reporting
No automatic local-stochastic fault model or collective optimum
costs: Actual finite calibration plus T service calls; 2q fresh frame bits and q fitted local inverses per on-site slot
Complete-process synthesis, storage, routing, feedback, key retirement and one bad-record debit; no accessible clean flag or residual-map implementation
contract.units: Bell loss/global Bell-test failure and averaged half-diamond or permitted strategy distance only where the source supplies that conversion. Block calls, total qubit traffic, bits, controls, routing and memory are separate.
contract.obstruction: Same-occupation regret and isolated-output factorization do not automatically compare adaptive reference trajectories.

evidence.quote: ## 4. Adaptive repeated service and counterfactual memory handled correctly
evidence.range_scope: Governing producer statement; retain the complete source contract and review scope.

body: The benchmark is the particular true-extraction process, not a noiseless computation, collective optimum or threshold. Uniform certification must hold for every compared history; occupied-gauge Bell scores are insufficient. Retired keys, emitted gauge and decoder records cannot later enter a source/controller port. Native Pauli errors may be large and non-identity-dominant. All implementation/privacy/controller costs and bad-calibration mass remain paid. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Acquired completed independent main/statistics review at the exact source version pinned in its receipt. Pending source headers are historical; actual conditional internal acceptance is sufficient. This insertion performs source correspondence and retrieval checks only.
